remarks: Enjoy easy, one-level living in the heart of New Canaan at Leefair, one of the town's most desirable in-town condominium communities. This beautifully updated 1,545-square-foot home offers two bedrooms plus a versatile office that can easily serve as a third bedroom, den, or guest space. The spacious living and dining room features a fireplace, beautiful built-ins and sliders opening to a private rear terrace, creating a wonderful setting for both everyday living and entertaining. Three circular skylights thoughtfully placed throughout the home bring in additional natural light. The updated eat-in kitchen is bright and inviting, while the primary bedroom features a beautifully renovated en-suite bath. A second updated full bath serves the additional bedroom and flexible office/guest space. A one-car garage plus driveway parking for 2-3 additional cars adds to the convenience. Move-in ready and just moments from New Canaan's shops, restaurants and train, this special home offers the perfect combination of single-level living, private outdoor space and an exceptional in-town lifestyle.
